process_area.title: Content Syndication, Channel Publishing & PIM Analytics

value_stream.name: Product Information Management (PIM) & Digital Asset Management (DAM)

fields.Trigger: Marketplace presence (VS-65); channel onboarding; catalog change
fields.Volume: Lazada/Shopee and other marketplace catalogs (subset/full of 35,000 SKUs)

Automation Opportunity: - Auto category-mapping suggestions; feed-error auto-classification; bulk listing templates
Controls: - CTL-643 (ensure controlled execution — Content Syndication, Channel Publishing & PIM Analytics (PA-137.3).)
- CTL-643: marketplace content sourced from canonical PIM (no manual channel-side edits); feed-error SLA
Cross-references: - links to VS-65 (marketplace), VS-48 (retail media), VS-10 (ecommerce), W4159 (publishing), VS-113.2 (integration)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Mapping-error risk**: Wrong category mapping → listing rejected/hidden; mitigated by mapping governance + acceptance monitoring
- **Channel-conflict risk**: Inconsistent content across channels; mitigated by canonical-source syndication
System Touchpoints: - Marketplace feed/API (VS-65); PIM syndication (W4159); retail-media (VS-48); integration bus (VS-27/VS-113.2)
Time Estimate: - Automated feed; ~0.5–1 FTE marketplace ops + exception handling

steps.activity: PIM/Ecommerce map BuildRight's canonical content to each marketplace's required taxonomy/attributes (Lazada/Shopee categories differ), and configure the feed transform rules per channel
PIM/Ecommerce run the syndication feed (product/price/availability/asset), monitor marketplace acceptance/rejections, and remediate category-mapping errors
PIM/Ecommerce handle marketplace-specific content (promotional copy, bundle listings, sponsored-content assets links to VS-48 retail media), and measure channel performance (W4163)

fields.Owner: PIM Content Lead / Ecommerce Operations (VS-10) / Pricing (VS-57)
fields.Volume: 35,000 SKUs × 6 channels; ~2.8M monthly POS + ~42,900 ecommerce orders/mo

Automation Opportunity: - Event-driven real-time price/promo/availability push; discrepancy auto-detection & alert
Controls: - CTL-643 (ensure controlled execution — Content Syndication, Channel Publishing & PIM Analytics (PA-137.3).)
- CTL-643: single authoritative pricing source; real-time sync with discrepancy monitoring (VS-118)
Cross-references: - links to VS-57 (pricing), VS-16 (price types), VS-58 (promotions), VS-05 (inventory), VS-85 (mandatory discount), VS-118 (revenue assurance), VS-10 (availability §8.4)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stale-price risk**: Channel shows wrong price → customer dispute/revenue leakage; mitigated by real-time sync + revenue-assurance monitoring (VS-118)
- **Availability-mismatch risk**: Online shows stock when out → failed fulfillment; mitigated by real-time per-store availability
System Touchpoints: - Pricing source (VS-57/VS-16); promotion engine (VS-58); inventory availability (VS-05/VS-10 §8.4); PIM syndication (W4159); revenue assurance (VS-118)
Time Estimate: - Automated real-time pipeline; ~0.3 FTE monitoring + exception

steps.activity: PIM/Ecommerce/Pricing sync price content (SRP, trade price, promo price) from the authoritative pricing source (VS-57/VS-16) to all channels in real-time, with display-price computation (VAT-inclusive, mandatory-discount links to VS-85)
steps.r: PIM Content Lead / Pricing / Ecommerce Ops

steps.activity: PIM/Ecommerce sync promotion content (badges, callouts, validity links to VS-58) and availability (per-store real-time stock links to VS-10 §8.4) consistently across channels
PIM/Ecommerce monitor sync latency/errors, reconcile price/availability discrepancies (links to VS-118 revenue-assurance price integrity), and escalate stale data

Automation Opportunity: - Auto content-gap detection from search analytics; A/B-test automation; SEO-scoring per SKU
Controls: - CTL-643 (ensure controlled execution — Content Syndication, Channel Publishing & PIM Analytics (PA-137.3).)
- CTL-643: content KPIs tied to revenue/conversion (not vanity metrics); A/B-test governance
Cross-references: - links to VS-10 (SEO/ecommerce analytics), VS-28 (BI), VS-44 (insights), VS-14 (marketing), W4149/W4156 (enrichment)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Blind-spot risk**: Low-performing content not identified → lost revenue; mitigated by per-SKU performance analytics
- **Vanity-metric risk**: Optimizing views not conversion; mitigated by tying content KPIs to conversion/attach (W4164)
System Touchpoints: - SEO/web analytics (VS-10); BI/analytics (VS-28); insights (VS-44); PIM completeness (W4147)

steps.activity: PIM/Ecommerce/SEO measure content performance — PDP views, search ranking, click-through, bounce, time-on-page, search-term gaps (zero-result queries) — per SKU/category/channel
PIM/SEO identify content gaps (low-completeness SKUs, missing keywords, poor images) and prioritize enrichment (links to W4149/W4156) by revenue/traffic impact
PIM/Marketing report content-performance KPIs, A/B test content variants, and feed learnings into category/content strategy (VS-01/VS-14)

fields.Volume: ~2.8M monthly POS + ~42,900 ecommerce orders/mo; ~600K loyalty members

Automation Opportunity: - Conversion-lift auto-attribution; basket/attach analytics automation; content-ROI dashboards
Controls: - CTL-643 (ensure controlled execution — Content Syndication, Channel Publishing & PIM Analytics (PA-137.3).)
- CTL-643: content-ROI measured with A/B-test rigor; cross-sell relevance monitored
Cross-references: - links to VS-10 (ecommerce analytics), VS-28 (BI), VS-126 (CDP/basket), VS-124 (selling), VS-01 (merchandising), W4151 (relationships)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Attribution risk**: Hard to isolate content's revenue impact; mitigated by A/B testing and conversion-lift measurement
- **Over-attach risk**: Aggressive cross-sell annoys shoppers; mitigated by relevance/basket analytics
System Touchpoints: - Ecommerce analytics (VS-10); BI/analytics (VS-28); CDP/basket data (VS-126); selling-enablement (VS-124)

steps.activity: PIM/Analytics measure content's revenue impact — conversion lift from complete vs incomplete content, attach from cross-sell/bundle (W4151), basket-size from how-to/rich content (W4156)
PIM/Merchandising measure cross-sell/bundle attach effectiveness (W4151) and clienteling/personalization lift (VS-126/VS-124) attributable to content, by category
PIM/Ecommerce report content-ROI (content investment vs conversion/attach/basket lift), prioritize the content backlog, and feed into merchandising/selling strategy (VS-01/VS-124)

fields.Participants: Vendor Mgmt (VS-03), Content teams, Scorecard (VS-67), Procurement (VS-15)

Automation Opportunity: - Auto SLA dashboards; scorecard auto-feed; bottleneck auto-detection
Controls: - CTL-149 (ensure product content accuracy & rights compliance.)
- CTL-643: vendor content-SLA in scorecard (VS-03/VS-67); internal SLA tracked and resourced
Cross-references: - links to VS-03 (vendor), VS-67 (scorecard), VS-15 (procurement), VS-03 (agreements)
Pain Points / Risks: - **No-consequence risk**: Poor vendor content SLA ignored → recurring delays; mitigated by scorecard consequence
- **Internal-bottleneck risk**: Content team under-resourced vs backlog; mitigated by SLA/burn-down visibility
System Touchpoints: - PIM SLA dashboards; vendor scorecard (VS-03/VS-67); procurement (VS-15)

steps.activity: PIM/Vendor Mgmt measure vendor content SLA performance — on-time content delivery, completeness, accuracy, SDS/cert timeliness (W4155) — per vendor
PIM measure internal content-team SLA (onboarding cycle time W4148, enrichment backlog burn-down, defect-fix time) and identify bottlenecks
PIM/Vendor Mgmt feed vendor content-SLA into the vendor scorecard (VS-67 W2347/VS-03), manage consequences (improvement plan), and report to merchandising/procurement

fields.Trigger: Data-quality audit; duplicate detection; governance review

workflows.name: Catalog Data Quality, Duplicate & GSR Remediation

Automation Opportunity: - Duplicate auto-detection (fuzzy match); inconsistency auto-scan; remediation auto-routing
Controls: - CTL-643 (ensure controlled execution — Content Syndication, Channel Publishing & PIM Analytics (PA-137.3).)
- CTL-643: duplicate/inconsistency KPIs in governance; intake controls prevent recurrence (VS-28.2)
Cross-references: - links to VS-28.2 (data quality), VS-29 (MDM), VS-21 (audit), VS-133 (OpEx), W4152 (intake)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Duplicate-SKU risk**: Same item twice → inventory/sales/pricing chaos; mitigated by dedup + intake control
- **Inconsistency risk**: Conflicting specs across channels; mitigated by canonical-source + quality checks
System Touchpoints: - PIM data-quality tooling; data-quality framework (VS-28.2 W2392); MDM (VS-29); audit (VS-21)

steps.activity: PIM/Data Gov run catalog data-quality checks — duplicates (same SKU ranged twice), inconsistencies (conflicting specs across channels), orphaned/incomplete records — and log issues
PIM/Merchandising resolve duplicates (merge/retire), standardize attribute values (links to W4146 dictionary), and remediate Global Source/brand registry (GSR) mismatches across import vendors
PIM/Data Gov report data-quality KPIs to governance (VS-28.2 W2392/VS-133), prevent recurrence via intake controls (W4152), and support audit (VS-21)

Automation Opportunity: - Event-content templates; scheduled publish/withdraw auto-execution; performance auto-recap
Controls: - CTL-643 (ensure controlled execution — Content Syndication, Channel Publishing & PIM Analytics (PA-137.3).)
- CTL-643: event content reviewed/approved; publish/withdraw windows enforced
Cross-references: - links to VS-14 (marketing/calendar/print W1270), VS-58 (promotions), VS-01 §13.2 (seasonal), VS-10 (landing pages), W4158 (retire)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Timing risk**: Seasonal content published late/withdrawn late; mitigated by scheduled publish/withdraw windows
- **Asset-overload risk**: Event content overwhelms core catalog; mitigated by phased scheduling
System Touchpoints: - PIM event/catalog mgmt; ecommerce landing pages (VS-10); print catalog (VS-14 W1270); promo engine (VS-58); DAM seasonal assets (W4153)

steps.activity: PIM/Marketing plan the seasonal/promotional catalog event — participating SKUs, themed content/assets, bundle/kit content (W4151), print-flyer extract (VS-14 W1270) — from the calendar
PIM/Marketing produce event-specific content (banners, landing pages, themed how-to, gift guides), schedule publish/withdraw windows across channels (W4159), and coordinate with promo pricing (VS-58)
PIM/Marketing measure event content performance (W4163/W4164), retire seasonal content post-event (W4158), and capture learnings for the next cycle

fields.Owner: PIM Product Owner / Enterprise Architecture (VS-113) / IT (VS-27)
fields.Trigger: Platform review; upgrade; integration change; lifecycle governance
fields.Volume: Enterprise PIM/DAM platform serving 6 channels + B2B

Automation Opportunity: - Platform health/usage monitoring; integration auto-monitoring; FinOps cost analytics (VS-135)
Controls: - CTL-149 (ensure product content accuracy & rights compliance.)
- CTL-643: platform lifecycle governed (VS-113); DR/BCP tested (VS-26); security/privacy assessed (VS-27.3/VS-91)
Cross-references: - links to VS-113 (EA), VS-113.2 (integration), VS-27 (IT ops), VS-135 (TBM/FinOps), VS-27.3 (security), VS-91 (privacy), VS-26 (DR/BCP), VS-29 (item master)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Platform-risk**: PIM/DAM outage halts all channels; mitigated by HA/DR (VS-26) and monitoring
- **Integration-debt risk**: Point-to-point integrations accumulate; mitigated by integration-layer governance (VS-113.2)
System Touchpoints: - PIM/DAM platform; integration layer (VS-113.2); TBM/FinOps (VS-135); InfoSec (VS-27.3); DR/BCP (VS-26)

steps.activity: PIM/EA/IT govern the PIM/DAM platform lifecycle — roadmap, upgrades, vendor management, scalability (35K→growth, asset volume), and cost (links to VS-135 TBM)

PIM/EA govern integration architecture (ERP item master VS-29, ecommerce VS-10, marketplace VS-65, retail-media VS-48, print, CDP VS-126) via the integration layer (VS-113.2) with versioning/monitoring
PIM/InfoSec govern platform security (access control, vendor portal VS-27.3, data privacy of customer-linked content VS-91), and conduct periodic DR/BCP testing (VS-26) for the content platform
